en.topic_title: Over 90% of public submissions support Hong Kong sexual offences reform, says security chief
en.topic_summary:
Over 90 per cent of more than 6,000 public submissions have voiced support for Hong Kong’s sexual offences reform, the city’s security chief has said, as he pledged to table a bill to the legislature within the year.
